name: 菜鸟裹裹
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=菜鸟裹裹
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = cn-acs.m.cainiao.com, amdc.m.taobao.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.adkeyword\.get\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.cncommunity\.my\.station\.query\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.guoguo\.nbnetflow\.ads\.(batch\.show\.v2|index)\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.nbopen\.miniapp\.recommend\.cpc\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.nbmensa\.research\.researchservice\.(acquire|event|close)\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.nbpresentation\.(homepage\.merge|tabbar\.marketing)\.get\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.com\.cainiao\.cnactivitycenter/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.com\.cainiao\.cncreditmarket\.hit\.getactivityhit\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.com\.cainiao\.longquan\.place\.getpageresourcecontent\.cn/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/guide-acs\.m\.taobao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.guoguo\.nbnetflow\.ads/i then reject(404)

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/amdc\.m\.taobao\.com\/amdc\/mobileDispatch$/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/header.js") with enable=${cdnngogo_enable}, tag="菜鸟裹裹", timeout=60
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.guoguo\.nbnetflow\.ads\.m?show\.cn/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/cainiao/cainiao.js") with enable=${cdnngogo_enable}, tag="菜鸟裹裹", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.cainiao\.nbpresentation\.(pickup\.empty\.page|protocol\.homepage)\.get\.cn/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/cainiao/cainiao.js") with enable=${cdnngogo_enable}, tag="菜鸟裹裹", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cn-acs\.m\.cainiao\.com\/gw\/mtop\.nbfriend\.message\.conversation\.list\.cn/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/cainiao/cainiao.js") with enable=${cdnngogo_enable}, tag="菜鸟裹裹", timeout=60, requires_body=true
